title: An effective, stimulating, interactive training
quote: I found this session with Martin really useful. He is clear, entertaining, open to discussions and ideas. He's a good listener and communicator. I really appreciated the interactive approach of the session which makes you feel always engaged, motivated and considered. Martin built the session around the participants, their roles, experiences and responses. He provided us with a lot of material to think about and gave us key elements to trigger new useful mechanisms in order to operate most effectively in our job. The session was not only standard information and concepts but it guided us towards new awareness and new approaches that can help us in our daily work situations and relationships. Martin presented us with hypothetical work situations and asked us to try and think how to better cope with them. Attitudes , individual barriers, strong and week points are some of the different aspects we've been trough during the whole process but I like that everything seemed to come naturally and that's obviously thanks to the great work Martin has done. Interesting points to me are: working on benefits and drawbacks while trying to lead people towards solutions or procedures or simply when we want to get answers; words, music(rhythm) and dance (body language) are all important in communication; neutral positioning (an opinion can be attached to us); the 5:45:10 style model; to mirror and to adapt are key aspects; change the emphasis from problems to solutions.
author: Alessandra Fiorenza
subject: Communication Skills
